title: Custom section + detail demo
description: Example Astro site that disables /work, /work/[slug], /writing, and /writing/[slug] from the editorial theme and replaces them with consumer-local pages.
tagline: End-to-end proof that disable + replace + tokens + components work together

contact.heading: About this demo
contact.body: This site exists to verify the engine's route disable + replace flow. See the README for how the four replacement screens are wired.
